simple.meaning: שְׁכֹבֶת (shᵉkôbeth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a (sexual) lying with.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁכֹבֶת (H7903) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 18:20, with occurrences in Leviticus, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁכֹבֶת (H7903) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁכֹבֶת (H7903) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁכֹבֶת (shᵉkôbeth) / H7903 is traced through Leviticus 18:20, Leviticus 18:23, Leviticus 20:15, Numbers 5:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “ ‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

majorEvents.label: Defilement
majorEvents.evidenceText: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

timeline.evidenceText: “ ‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
“ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
“ ‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”
